_readme: Hand-maintained event facts. npm run event merges this with what it reads from data/luma-events into src/data/event.json. listed=true puts the tab in the nav (labelled with name) while live=false keeps it a preview: every minigame shows, with the scaffolding disclaimer. live=true means the event is running. activeGames lists minigame keys confirmed for this event; once live, only those show. newGames lists games running this event that the pinned code doesn't have (name, and a summary from the announcement), so they show without a guide. command, dates, token.name and token.earnedBy come from the event's announcement. trickOrTreat (null if the event has none) is read in game, like the shop. sourceEvent names the event the luma-events code at data/luma-events.commit was written for; while it differs from name, the pages say the numbers come from that event's code.

newGames.summary: A casual memory game with no PvP. Memorize a build in 16 seconds, then restore the parts of it that were removed.
